evidence.claim: SPS Commerce describes itself as an intelligent supply-chain network connecting trading partners globally and says over 50,000 recurring-revenue customers across retail, grocery, distribution, supply, manufacturing, and logistics use SPS as their retail network.

SPS Commerce 2024 Form 10-K describes recurring-revenue customers using SPS products to expand and optimize the performance of trading relationships and refers to access to a large retail network of trading partners.
evidence.source_title: Form 10-K for SPS Commerce Inc. filed 02/19/2025

evidence.claim: A third-party deep dive frames SPS as a retail network connecting major retailers and supplier bases, with high recurring revenue and operational rather than purely contractual switching costs; this supports the discovery hypothesis but should be verified against company filings.

evidence.claim: Descartes Q1 FY27 shareholder report refers to its Logistics Network and global supply-chain challenges affecting suppliers with end-customers.

evidence.source_title: B2B Integration Platform & Supply Chain Solutions | OpenText

evidence.source_title: Retail and Supply Chain Management Software Solutions | Manhattan Associates

evidence.claim: E2open would have been a relevant public candidate, but WiseTech completed its acquisition of E2open in 2025, so it is excluded from the US-listed candidate universe for this pass.
evidence.source_title: WiseTech Global completes strategic acquisition of e2open

memory_update.text: SPSC is the primary pure-play US-listed candidate for retailer-supplier transaction and compliance networks; prioritize in Layer 2 evidence work.
DSGX and OTEX are relevant adjacent network operators, but their retail-supplier exposure must be isolated from broader logistics or enterprise-software revenue.

Need to verify whether any smaller US-listed companies remain in retail EDI/supplier compliance after E2open's acquisition by WiseTech; many direct competitors appear private or embedded in diversified software firms.

The most important falsification variable is churn/replacement evidence: if suppliers and retailers can migrate EDI/compliance networks cheaply or if new API-native platforms displace legacy networks quickly, the bottleneck hypothesis weakens.

summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed public-company universe around retailer-supplier transaction and compliance networks. The cleanest underfollowed exposure is SPS Commerce, a mid-cap retail EDI and supplier-network operator. Descartes and OpenText provide adjacent transaction-network exposure through logistics/B2B integration networks, while Manhattan Associates is included as a reference leader for retail supply-chain execution but is less pure to the EDI/compliance-network bottleneck. This pass is research-only and does not make buy/sell recommendations.
